operating_policy.scope: Subphase 6 (6.4) only; GraphSAGE Org1-Org5; no training, recalibration or model selection

demonstration.scope: Representative real full-hour integration in all five organizations, not full 513-variant final evaluation
demonstration.repeat: Uninterrupted replay versus independent replay with a mid-hour close/restart and journal recovery
demonstration.end: Every observation in [anchor,end_exclusive), heartbeats at offsets 0,10,20,30,40,50 minutes plus end_exclusive minus 1 microsecond; do not stop at minute 50

operating_policy.event_contract: Caller supplies a complete timestamp batch, observable columns only and stable local ingestion tokens. No within-timestamp partial decisions. Reject duplicate tokens or time <= closed graph clock. A watermark/complete-batch adapter is required for a real live producer.
operating_policy.scoring_policy: After mutation, score surviving User nodes in the union of pre/post graph two-hop closures of changed event endpoints. Changed endpoints include incoming events and events expiring from ten-minute or seven-day windows. On heartbeat/final flush also score all observable recent User nodes. No labels, campaign membership or attacker metadata selects targets.
operating_policy.graph: The accepted seven-day RollingGraph instance is updated in place. An additive adjacency index supports target discovery only; it never supplies model features. Accepted detection_view, TemporalNeighborSampler, schema, transforms, fanouts and seed are unchanged.
operating_policy.sampling_namespace: Opaque local stream identifier is passed as the accepted sampler's branch namespace. Demonstration reuses the frozen variant identifier solely for reproducible sampling and source provenance, not target selection or features.
operating_policy.decision: Reuse sealed GraphSAGE thresholds and the accepted binary64 decisions helper on unrounded logits. Probability is diagnostic only. No event-driven FPR guarantee follows from fixed-grid VAL calibration.

persistence.engine: Per-organization SQLite WAL with synchronous FULL
persistence.atomic_commit: Input command, private event-token ledger, all score/alert records and view digest in one transaction. Periodic accepted-runtime checkpoint and sequence are committed consistently.
persistence.recovery: Verify bundle/stream/org/source identities, restore the latest hashed graph checkpoint and replay only committed journal commands after it. Restore source offset; verify final view digest. Never replay uncommitted alerts.
persistence.failure: Log rejected input without graph mutation. A feature/scoring/storage failure after mutation faults the client; refuse further processing until restart restores committed state. Never label processing failure as no-alert.

operating_policy.registry: Load the original hash-pinned accepted model/threshold/config/schema/protocol bundle. Reject invalid replacement candidates and retain the current usable bundle. No federated adoption or ledger verification implemented.
operating_policy.privacy: Raw commands, local User IDs, graph checkpoints and decisions stay in separate organization-local stores. Export only aggregate evidence. Logical isolation on a single-user research host is not production tenant authorization.
operating_policy.evaluation: Operational units are timestamp-triggered local User scores and heartbeat scores; separate from frozen primary fixed-grid eligible User-window metrics. No TEST files/outcomes, FPR/recall claim, campaign ground-truth join or re-selection in this subphase.
operating_policy.future_components: No indicator sharing, federation, differential privacy, blockchain or deployment service

research_boundary: No TEST, labels, threshold/model selection or event-driven FPR claim; one representative full VAL hour per org plus exact restart repeat
